annotations.title: Read the workspace's plan and usage

description: Report the workspace's plan (Free, complimentary, or an Everything volume and billing period), this month's response count against its allowance, recent monthly usage, and the Settings link where an owner or admin changes the plan. Read-only: no tool can subscribe, change the plan, or open checkout — report the numbers and hand the human manageUrl. Needs a LOGIN TOKEN — billing has no project-API-key route.
name: fillo_get_billing
